dipole_bounds_note: Pre-registered 3.6e-6 = +3.7 fs/s / coef (1-sigma error bar on |Pbdot_D|, sign ignored). Corrected: Freire sec. 4.2 Pbdot_D = Pbdot_xs - Pbdot_Gdot = 1.9(+3.8/-3.7) fs/s; a non-ghost scalar radiates (Pbdot_D < 0), so the -3.7 side and the +1.9 central value bound it (D_1sigma, D_2sigma); under the repo's repulsive sign read as a ghost (Pbdot_D > 0) the +3.8 side applies (D_repulsive_*). xs_* use Pbdot_xs before the Gdot subtraction (v1 values).

routes.b_note: upper bound on lambda from THESE FIVE ROWS ONLY. Not evaluated: ground torsion-balance EP tests (Schlamminger 2008: ranges 1 m to infinity) and inverse-square-law tests (Lee 2020: gravitational-strength Yukawa excluded beyond 38.6 um). The coded coupling has a universal Yukawa strength alpha^2 = 0.31 and a composition-dependent part 2 xi Delta f ~ 7e-4, so these tests very likely push lambda_max far below 34 km [SPECULATIVE magnitude, not computed].

c_notation.statement: sigma == -2 xi Phi/c^2 as universal, non-dynamical notation; drops the sigma-invariant m_e/alpha_EM/bond rules
c_notation.rows: all five pass BY CONSTRUCTION (no observable)
c_notation.caveat: passes only if e^sigma is a change of units (all dimensionful constants together); a mass-only universal rescale is excluded by Cassini

mentat_diagnostics.defect: all three tools call _sympify(expression) before creating sp.Symbol(variable); a variable named E (likewise I, N, S, O, Q) is parsed as a sympy constant, and the answer is silently wrong. Fix direction: sympify with locals={variable: Symbol(variable)}.
